items.title: Ben Sidran interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 15, 2023
items.q: I’m getting closer to Leonard Cohen every day.

ctx.x: Later today if you went out to continue your day, what kind of things might you hear or see that could lead to a song title and a song?

Well today, let’s see — I’m trying to think the last few songs I wrote here where I am. That’s funny — not funny — but this last year I turned 80 and I started writing some very dystopic songs. I mean I’ve always — you know people accused Mose Allison of being cynical. And he would say, “I’m not cynical I’m just telling it like it is.” And I would always have to kind of half apologize after singing one of my songs like “I may be wrong but it sure seems to me the past ain’t what it was and the future ain’t what it…

Good analogy. So I’m sitting here thinking how to respond to what you just said and I wonder if in all the interviewing that you’ve done, have you ever had a similar situation, who was interviewing someone who is approaching 80 and looking at the world at that time and suggesting a similar attitude. What would you have said to them?
